def bfs_at_depth(graph, start, target_depth):
    """Find all nodes at exactly target_depth from start node using BFS"""

    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])  # (node, depth)

    """Find all nodes at exactly target_depth from start node using BFS"""

    queue = deque([(start, 0)])  # (node, depth)

def bfs_at_depth(graph, start, target_depth):
    """Find all nodes at exactly target_depth from start node using BFS"""
    if target_depth == 0:
        return set()
    
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])  # (node, depth)
    depth_nodes = {i: set() for i in range(target_depth + 1)}

    """Find all nodes at exactly target_depth from start node using BFS"""

        return set()
    
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])  # (node, depth)
